items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 96:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the radiance and the spark of the river that comes out of Eden? It is known that the Chochma Stima'ah of AA was corrected in the Nukva, and it took Bina out from the head, to the aspect of the throat and the HGT. And the Yesod of the Chochma Stima'ah, in which is its screen of the Nukva, namely the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, is found to take Bina out, by which the illumination of AB and Hochma was cut off from the ZON, for Bina cannot bestow Hochma to him after it came out of the head. Therefore the Yesod of the Mocha Stima'ah is discerned as the aspect of Daat, separating between AA and the ZON. However, at the time of the coupling, the screen of the Chochma Stima'ah descends from there to the aspect of the mouth, namely in the place of the chest of AA, and the HGT of AA rise and become his KHB, and the coupling of the palate and the throat of AA is made in the secret of the bowing of his head downward, and the mouth descends to the place of the former chest, and the Mazal VeNotzer is included in the palate of AA in the place of the former chest, and the Mazal VeNakeh is included in the throat of AA, which stands at the point of this chest. And then the Mochin of AB come out to Aba and Ima. Behold, that at the time of the return of the Bina of AA to his head, the Yesod of AA, together with the Mazalot, becomes the aspect of Daat for Aba and Ima, which is the Bina that returned to the head.
